suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 affects org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-gradle-plugin build-cache deserialization before 2.4.20-Beta1. Dependency-Check incorrectly maps the product-wide Kotlin CPE to unrelated Kotlin runtime artifacts. Reviewed advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-r937-wjx7-w2jp

CVE-2020-29582 affects org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-stdlib through 1.4.20. Dependency-Check incorrectly maps it to kotlin-stdlib-common 1.9.10. Reviewed advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-cqj8-47ch-rvvq
These CVEs affect Android SDK native image parsing and dexdump, not the test-scoped Maven repackage of Android's org.json implementation.

CVE-2026-66299 exists only in Tomcat's deployable WebSocket chat example. The embedded Maven artifacts do not contain that example application. Apache advisory: https://tomcat.apache.org/security-11.html#Fixed_in_Apache_Tomcat_11.0.25
